My Repository

This is a repository of apps to be used with F-Droid. Applications in this repository are official binaries built by the original application developers and released on the official github pages.

Currently it serves 2 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thesameone-hub/android-foss-tv/main/fdroid/repo
